desc: Parse input, build adjacency lists for original and reversed edges.
Build combined state graph with 2N nodes, edges for moves (cost 1) and flips (cost X).
Run Dijkstra from state (1,0) using a heap, tracking distances in a 2D array.
Implement `solve()`: read N, M, X, build graph, run Dijkstra, output minimum.
Test on provided samples (1-4) and ensure correct handling of large answers.
